Records through 22 October 2026

About this tracker

We connect monthly Council records so you can follow one issue over time. The summaries are AI-written explanations; original wording and source links let you check them.

“Completed” in Council’s tracker can refer to a report or an individual task. It does not necessarily mean an entire issue is resolved.

Includes every resolution listed in the nine 2026 tracker editions available through 22 October 2026. Related earlier decisions and available comments are included back to 2023 where applicable. View the coverage record.

“First appeared” is the earliest available tracker edition containing a decision on this page. The Council decision itself may be older. Tile shades use the latest dated note or reported status/target change, measured against 22 October 2026.

The September 2023 attachment is unavailable from Council’s official link. December 2023 links to November’s identical PDF. The website flags these limits and preserves available later records; gaps are not filled with invented updates.

This website is independent of Council. It reflects the published records reviewed and is not a live service. Recommendations in the latest meeting papers are not treated as adopted decisions.
